files..agent-checks/local.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# This repo's own agent-checks: draft files stay out of it.
status=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  case "$path" in
    *.draft) echo "agent-checks (local): $path: drafts stay out of this repo. Move it to your notes." >&2; status=1 ;;
  esac
done
exit $status
